name: @calibress/rwav-bridge-mcp

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List available Roon zones with outputs

tools.name: ai_status
tools.description: Get AI provider/model/persona status

tools.name: health
tools.description: Get discovery/health status

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Get MCP server info (name, version, startup_time)

tools.name: get_default_zone
tools.description: Get current default zone id

tools.name: set_default_zone
tools.description: Persist default zone id for later calls

tools.name: get_zone
tools.description: Fetch full zone including now_playing

tools.name: get_artwork
tools.description: Build artwork URLs for an image_key. Defaults to original image; set thumbnail=true for a scaled image.

tools.name: get_nowplaying_artwork
tools.description: Get album and artist artwork URLs for the current now playing item. Defaults to original images; set thumbnail=true for scaled images.

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: Get concise now playing info (title/artist/album/progress) with optional artwork.

tools.name: get_queue_artwork
tools.description: Get album and artist artwork URLs for upcoming queue items. Defaults to original images; set thumbnail=true for scaled images.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Transport: play

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Transport: pause

tools.name: play_pause_toggle
tools.description: Transport: play pause toggle

tools.name: next
tools.description: Transport: next

tools.name: previous
tools.description: Transport: previous

tools.name: volume_set
tools.description: Set absolute volume (0..100) with safety guards

tools.name: volume_adjust
tools.description: Adjust volume by small delta (default ±3)

tools.name: seek
tools.description: Seek playback position (absolute or relative seconds)

tools.name: mute
tools.description: Mute or unmute an output in a zone

tools.name: mute_all
tools.description: Mute all outputs (global when zoneId omitted; scoped to zone when provided)

tools.name: unmute_all
tools.description: Unmute all outputs (global when zoneId omitted; scoped to zone when provided)

tools.name: list_outputs
tools.description: List available outputs (display_name mapped to name)

tools.name: list_group_candidates
tools.description: List outputs that can be grouped with a given primary output. If none provided, uses first output of a named zone.

tools.name: group_outputs
tools.description: Group outputs under a primary output. Bridge endpoint must support grouping.

tools.name: group_zones
tools.description: Group outputs into a single zone (requires 2+ output_ids).

tools.name: ungroup_zones
tools.description: Ungroup outputs from a zone.

tools.name: ungroup_output
tools.description: Ungroup a specific output from any group. Bridge endpoint must support ungrouping.

tools.name: transfer_playback
tools.description: Transfer playback (and queue) to another zone. Tips: call list_zones just before this to ensure fresh zone IDs; iOS outputs (e.g., iPhone) may need the device unlocked/active to appear.

tools.name: tools_bridge_connection_status
tools.description: Return the current RWAV Bridge connection status (connected/unavailable) and transport source (bonjour/ssdp/manual). Use this to confirm that the MCP has a reachable RWAV Bridge instance before issuing playback or queue operations.

tools.name: tools_help_open
tools.description: Open RWAV Bridge MCP Help page

tools.name: tools_service_info_get
tools.description: Get service-specific guidance and reliability notes for TIDAL/Qobuz. Use this to decide whether to prefer typed section readers (albums/playlists/tracks) or raw node_open navigation, and to understand known quirks before browsing or executing playback actions.

tools.name: tools_bridge_version_get
tools.description: Return the installed RWAV Bridge version, plus the MCP server version. Use this to confirm that discovery and connection succeeded. Does not perform any browsing or playback operations.

tools.name: tools_bridge_set_base
tools.description: Manually set the RWAV Bridge base URL or host. Use this when auto-discovery is blocked or misconfigured. Verify the new base via /capabilities; do not set repeatedly if verification fails. This affects all subsequent tool calls until cleared.

tools.name: tools_bridge_unset_base
tools.description: Clear the manually set RWAV Bridge base URL. After unsetting, discovery will revert to bonjour/ssdp. Use when switching network environments or repairing misconfigurations.

tools.name: tools_playlist_discard
tools.description: Discard a staged custom playlist plan

tools.name: tools_tracks_addnext_bulk
tools.description: Bulk Add Next for ordered trackKeys (stable order, server-side). Use pause_for_addnext to control final state restoration for addnext (false restores pre-state; true allows paused; omitted preserves current behaviour). If pause_for_addnext is explicitly false, stable ordering is disabled to ensure non-disruptive playback (no internal pause).

tools.name: tools_genres_list
tools.description: List Library/TIDAL/Qobuz genres (paged). Use this as the entrypoint for genre-based browsing.

tools.name: tools_settings_list
tools.description: List Settings subsections from Home (e.g., Profile, Display Settings)

tools.name: tools_settings_profiles_get
tools.description: Read Settings → Profile (current + available profiles)

tools.name: tools_settings_display_list
tools.description: Read Settings → Display Settings (titles + current state)

tools.name: tools_settings_profile_set
tools.description: Set the current Profile (executes the Profile action node and confirms selection)

tools.name: tools_genre_artists_list
tools.description: List Artists within a Genre (paged). Use this BEFORE opening a specific artist with tools_artist_open. Read-only.

tools.name: tools_genre_albums_list
tools.description: List Albums within a Genre (paged). Use this BEFORE opening a specific album. Read-only.

tools.name: tools_tidal_open
tools.description: Open the TIDAL hub (service tiles such as What’s New, Rising, Playlists, Genres, Your Favorites). This is the recommended entrypoint for browsing TIDAL content. Always reuse the sessionId from this card for follow-up calls (sections, typed lists, node_open).

tools.name: tools_tidal_section_open
tools.description: Open a TIDAL tile and optionally list a known sub-section (albums/playlists/tracks). Use this to drill into a specific TIDAL shelf using the sessionId from tools_tidal_open. Prefer this over ad-hoc node navigation when a typed section is available; fall back to tools_node_open only if the typed section is empty or unavailable.

tools.name: tools_tidal_albums_list
tools.description: List TIDAL albums from a specific section (paged). Use this after tools_tidal_open or tools_tidal_section_open with the same sessionId and nodeKey. Prefer this typed list for deterministic album browsing before opening an album via tools_album_open.

tools.name: tools_tidal_playlists_list
tools.description: List TIDAL playlists from a specific section (paged). Use this after tools_tidal_open or tools_tidal_section_open with the same sessionId and nodeKey. Prefer playlist-level tools (tools_playlist_open / tools_playlist_play_now) once a playlist is selected.

tools.name: tools_tidal_tracks_list
tools.description: List TIDAL tracks from a specific section (paged). Use this after tools_tidal_open or tools_tidal_section_open with the same sessionId and nodeKey. For an individual track, open it with tools_track_open and execute via tools_track_play_now / tools_track_add_next / tools_track_queue.

tools.name: tools_qobuz_open
tools.description: Open the Qobuz hub (tiles such as What’s New, Taste of Qobuz, Your Favorites). This is the recommended entrypoint for browsing Qobuz content. Always reuse the sessionId from this card for Qobuz section/list calls and node_open navigation.

tools.name: tools_qobuz_section_open
tools.description: Open a Qobuz tile and optionally list a known sub-section (albums/playlists/tracks). Use this to drill into a Qobuz shelf using the sessionId from tools_qobuz_open. Typed section readers may be inconsistent on some cores/regions; when a typed section is empty, fall back to tools_node_open on the same nodeKey instead of retrying blindly.

tools.name: tools_qobuz_albums_list
tools.description: List Qobuz albums from a specific section (paged). Use this after tools_qobuz_open or tools_qobuz_section_open with the same sessionId and nodeKey. If this typed list is empty, follow the tool advice to try tools_node_open instead of retrying blindly.

tools.name: tools_qobuz_playlists_list
tools.description: List Qobuz playlists from a specific section (paged). Use this after tools_qobuz_open or tools_qobuz_section_open. Once you select a playlist, prefer playlist-level tools (tools_playlist_open / tools_playlist_play_now).

tools.name: tools_qobuz_tracks_list
tools.description: List Qobuz tracks from a specific section (paged). Use this after tools_qobuz_open or tools_qobuz_section_open. For a chosen track, open it with tools_track_open and execute via tools_track_play_now / tools_track_add_next / tools_track_queue.

tools.name: tools_playlist_preflight
tools.description: Preflight a set of playlist or track items to determine can_addnext / can_queue semantics. Helps construct playlist plans and avoid invalid per-track loops.

tools.name: tools_capabilities
tools.description: Return RWAV Bridge capabilities, including available tool groups and features. Use this early in a session to understand available playback, queue, search, streaming and device features.

tools.name: tools_album_preflight
tools.description: Preflight an album for Add Next / Queue (read-only)

tools.name: tools_db_zones_list
tools.description: List zones (DB view of activity/plays)

tools.name: tools_db_zones_get
tools.description: Get a zone record (DB view)

tools.name: tools_history_artists_list
tools.description: List history artists (read-only; search optional). Use this to explore played artists in history/analytics views; does not control playback.

tools.name: tools_history_artist_get
tools.description: Get a history artist record by id (read-only). Use this to inspect analytics metadata about an artist; not for playback control.

tools.name: tools_history_albums_list
tools.description: List history albums (read-only; filter by artistId/search). Use this for analytics/history browsing, not for controlling playback.

tools.name: tools_history_album_get
tools.description: Get history album by id (read-only). Use this to inspect a played album record; not for playback control.

tools.name: tools_history_tracks_list
tools.description: List tracks from the RWAV history database (read-only), with optional filters by albumId/artistId/search. Use this to inspect what has been played over time, not to control playback.

tools.name: tools_history_track_get
tools.description: Get a single history track record by id (read-only). Use this to inspect metadata about a track that has been played, not for playback control.

tools.name: tools_history_plays_list
tools.description: List plays (listening events) with filters + paging (zoneId/trackId/date range). Read-only analytics; use this for reporting or visualisation of listening history, not for controlling playback.

tools.name: tools_history_play_get
tools.description: Get a single play event by id (history record). Read-only; exposes when/what played, not a way to replay it.

tools.name: tools_snapshots_recently_played
tools.description: Get a snapshot of recently played items (scope=all|zone). Read-only analytics for building “recently played” views, not for modifying the queue.

tools.name: tools_snapshots_most_played_tracks
tools.description: Get a snapshot of most played tracks (optionally scoped by zone and date range). Read-only analytics useful for “most played” charts, not for queue control.

tools.name: tools_snapshots_most_played_artists
tools.description: Get a snapshot of most played artists (optionally scoped by zone and date range). Read-only analytics, suitable for top-artist views.

tools.name: tools_snapshots_most_played_albums
tools.description: Get a snapshot of most played albums (optionally scoped by zone and date range). Read-only analytics for surfacing favourite albums.

tools.name: tools_snapshots_listening_time_daily
tools.description: Get a snapshot of listening time per day (optionally scoped by zone and date range). Purely read-only analytics, intended for charts/usage insights.

tools.name: tools_snapshots_track_first_last
tools.description: Get first/last play timestamps for a given trackId. Read-only analytics; use this for “when did I first/last play this?” insights.

tools.name: tools_instructions_startup
tools.description: Return the RWAV startup instructions and global usage rules. This is the main reference for safe, efficient use of RWAV tools (search-first, session reuse, execute-once-then-verify, queue head/tail helpers, streaming fallbacks, volume safety).

tools.name: tools_discovery
tools.description: Return all public RWAV tools and metadata. This is the main entrypoint for MPC tool discovery. Use this to enumerate available functionality, then follow specific navigation/playback/search tools as needed.

tools.name: tools_playlists_drafts_create
tools.description: Create an in-memory playlist draft (transient). Use this as an alternative to playlist_plan when building multi-item sets. Execute via tools_playlists_execute; do not issue per-track operations.

tools.name: tools_playlists_drafts_get
tools.description: Retrieve an in-memory playlist draft. Read-only; used for inspection before executing the draft.

tools.name: tools_playlists_drafts_update
tools.description: Update an in-memory playlist draft (add/remove/reorder items). Execute via tools_playlists_execute only once per intent.

tools.name: tools_playlists_drafts_delete
tools.description: Delete an in-memory playlist draft. Used to clean up transient plans.

tools.name: tools_playlists_execute
tools.description: Execute an in-memory playlist draft using append/addnext semantics. On addnext, use pause_for_addnext to control final zone state: false restores the original play/pause state (non‑disruptive), true allows the zone to remain paused; omitted preserves current behaviour. Optional de‑dupe drops unintended duplicates within the draft and near the insertion window. Idempotent within TTL. Execute ONCE, then verify via recommended head/tail helpers.

tools.name: tools_zones_list
tools.description: List zones (public surface; wrapper over list_zones)

tools.name: tools_zones_get_default
tools.description: Get default zone id (public surface)

tools.name: tools_zones_set_default
tools.description: Set default zone id (public surface)

tools.name: tools_outputs_list
tools.description: List outputs for a given zone or all outputs on the Core, mapping output_id to display name. Read-only helper used before volume/mute/grouping operations.

tools.name: tools_outputs_list_group_candidates
tools.description: List outputs that can be grouped with a primary output (based on can_group_with_output_ids). Use this before tools_group_zones or tools_outputs_group to avoid illegal groupings.

tools.name: tools_outputs_group
tools.description: Group outputs under a primary output (local RAAT grouping). Requires a primary_output_id and one or more output_ids that are compatible. Use tools_outputs_list_group_candidates first.

tools.name: tools_outputs_ungroup
tools.description: Ungroup outputs (per-output fallback). Use this to break groups where tools_group_zones or tools_outputs_group were used. Read the results array to see which outputs succeeded.

tools.name: tools_group_zones
tools.description: Group outputs into a single zone (cloud-style grouping). Requires 2+ output_ids that are mutually groupable via can_group_with_output_ids. Use tools_outputs_list and tools_outputs_list_group_candidates before calling this.

tools.name: tools_playlist_capabilities
tools.description: Report playlist capabilities (addnext/append/play/shuffle). Use this BEFORE executing operations to ensure the platform supports the requested action.

tools.name: tools_playlist_plan
tools.description: Create a transient playlist plan for bulk Add Next or Queue operations. Use this when you have multiple items or queries; do NOT call track_add_next or track_queue repeatedly. Execute once via tools_playlist_execute, then verify via head/tail snapshots (tools_queue_head_get or tools_queue_tail_get).

tools.name: tools_playlist_execute
tools.description: Execute a transient playlist plan (append or addnext) in a single operation. On addnext, use pause_for_addnext to control final zone state: false restores the original play/pause state (non‑disruptive), true allows the zone to remain paused after queue surgery; when omitted, current behaviour is preserved. Optional de‑dupe drops unintended duplicates within the plan and near the insertion window. You may override the plan strategy at execution by passing strategy (useful after previewing the plan). Execute ONCE, then verify via queue head/tail as advised.

tools.name: tools_job_status_get
tools.description: Get status of an asynchronous job

tools.name: tools_ungroup_zones
tools.description: Ungroup outputs from a zone

tools.name: tools_ungroup_output
tools.description: Ungroup a specific output from any group

tools.name: tools_transfer_playback
tools.description: Transfer playback (track, queue context, position, and state) to another zone. Playback state is preserved by the Core: if the source was playing, the destination will be playing; if paused, it remains paused. Do not auto‑toggle play/pause after transfer — verify via tools_now_playing_get before any transport actions.

tools.name: tools_library_albums_list
tools.description: List Library → Albums (paged). Use this to browse Library albums, then open a selected album with tools_album_open for actions and playback. Read-only browser, not a playback action.

tools.name: tools_library_artists_list
tools.description: List Library → Artists (paged). Use this to browse Library artists, then open a selected artist with tools_artist_open. Read-only; artist-level actions are performed via tools_artist_open and tools_artist_play_now.

tools.name: tools_library_composers_list
tools.description: List Library → Composers (paged). Use this to browse Library composers, then open a specific composer via tools_composer_open for actions (Play/Shuffle/Radio). Read-only navigation.

tools.name: tools_library_tracks_list
tools.description: List Library → Tracks (paged). Use this when you need a broad view of Library tracks. For targeted playback, prefer search-first flows (tools_search_run or tools_track_search_open) plus tools_track_open/tools_track_play_now.

tools.name: tools_library_tags_list
tools.description: List Library → Tags (paged). Use this to discover available tags, then open a tag with tools_tag_open for actions and rows.

tools.name: tools_tag_open
tools.description: Open a Library Tag and return actions (Shuffle, Start Radio) plus optional track/album rows. Use this to explore tagged content. If the tag resolves to an owner action_list, open that owner and execute the child action via tools_play_by_key. Prefer tag-level actions over iterating individual tracks or albums.

tools.name: tools_tag_play_now
tools.description: Start tag playback via Shuffle or Radio. Single-shot action; execute once and verify via tools_now_playing_get. Do not iterate track rows unless the user selects a specific item.

tools.name: tools_library_playlists_list
tools.description: List Library → Playlists (paged). Use this to browse Library playlists, then open a playlist with tools_playlist_open. Prefer playlist-level actions (Play Now/Add Next/Queue) over per-track iteration.

tools.name: tools_library_playlists_pick
tools.description: Pick N Library → Playlists items and return action-ready entries.

tools.name: tools_playlist_open
tools.description: Open a playlist and retrieve playlist actions (Play Now, Shuffle, Add Next, Queue, Start Radio) and track rows. Prefer playlist-level actions to per-track actions. If the playlist is a curated wrapper, detect the owner action_list and use tools_play_by_key for execution.

tools.name: tools_playlist_search_open
tools.description: Search for playlists, then open a playlist with fresh session context. Use this to avoid stale playlistKeys. After opening, prefer playlist-level actions to row-level iteration.

tools.name: tools_playlist_open_simple
tools.description: Open a Library/TIDAL/Qobuz playlist using a simple title or playlistKey, resolving owner action_list keys. Useful for curated wrappers; always use playlist-level actions from the returned card.

tools.name: tools_playlist_play_now_simple
tools.description: Start playlist playback immediately. This is a playlist-level action; do NOT loop per-track. Verify playback with tools_now_playing_get (and tools_queue_head_get if needed).

tools.name: tools_playlist_play_now
tools.description: Start playlist playback immediately. This is a playlist-level action; do NOT loop per-track. Verify playback with tools_now_playing_get (and tools_queue_head_get if needed). If reason:"curated_wrapper" is returned, open the owner via tools_node_open and execute the child action via tools_play_by_key. Do NOT iterate track rows for curated playlists.

tools.name: tools_playlist_shuffle
tools.description: Start playlist playback immediately. This is a playlist-level action; do NOT loop per-track. Verify playback with tools_now_playing_get (and tools_queue_head_get if needed).

tools.name: tools_playlist_add_next
tools.description: Add an entire playlist immediately after the current track. Execute ONCE per intent and verify via tools_queue_head_get. If duplicate within idempotency TTL, perform verification only (do NOT re-inject). If reason:"curated_wrapper" is returned, open the owner via tools_node_open and execute the child action via tools_play_by_key. Do NOT iterate track rows for curated playlists.

tools.name: tools_playlist_queue
tools.description: Append a playlist to the tail of the queue. Execute ONCE per intent; verify via tools_queue_tail_get. Use playlist-level actions rather than adding tracks individually. If reason:"curated_wrapper" is returned, open the owner via tools_node_open and execute the child action via tools_play_by_key. Do NOT iterate track rows for curated playlists.

tools.name: tools_playlist_start_radio
tools.description: Start a radio session from the playlist. Stateless one-shot action; no need to iterate track rows. Verify playback state via tools_now_playing_get.

tools.name: tools_playlist_track_open
tools.description: Open a specific playlist track and return a per‑track actions card

tools.name: tools_playlist_play_from_here
tools.description: Play From Here for a track inside a playlist. Execute ONCE, then verify via tools_now_playing_get and/or tools_queue_head_get. This tool is idempotent within TTL; duplicate calls MUST trigger verification only, not a new injection.

tools.name: tools_playlist_track_play_now
tools.description: Play a specific track inside a playlist. Verify playback with tools_now_playing_get. Use ONLY when the user explicitly requests a single track from the playlist.

tools.name: tools_playlist_track_add_next
tools.description: Add a specific playlist track immediately next. Verify via tools_queue_head_get. Avoid using this for whole-playlist Add Next; prefer tools_playlist_add_next.

tools.name: tools_playlist_track_queue
tools.description: Append a specific playlist track to the queue. Verify via tools_queue_tail_get. Avoid per-track queueing when a playlist-level action is available.

tools.name: tools_playlist_track_start_radio
tools.description: Start a radio session from this playlist track. Use only when the user selects a specific track. Verify via tools_now_playing_get.

tools.name: tools_now_playing_get
tools.description: Get a Now Playing snapshot for the effective zone (state, title/artist/album, position, volume, outputs). Use this to verify the result of playback and transport actions (play/pause/seek/shuffle/repeat/auto_radio) before deciding to retry anything.

tools.name: tools_now_playing_playpause
tools.description: Toggle play/pause for the current zone. This is a simple transport toggle; execute once and verify state via tools_now_playing_get instead of sending repeated toggles.

tools.name: tools_now_playing_next
tools.description: Skip to the next track in the queue for the current zone. Execute once, then verify via tools_now_playing_get or tools_queue_head_get.

tools.name: tools_now_playing_previous
tools.description: Skip to the previous track in the queue for the current zone. Execute once, then verify via tools_now_playing_get.

tools.name: tools_now_playing_seek
tools.description: Seek to an absolute position (ms) in the current track. Validates against track length when available and clamps near the end by default. Execute once and verify via tools_now_playing_get instead of issuing repeated seeks.

tools.name: tools_now_playing_shuffle
tools.description: Set shuffle mode on/off for the current zone. Execute once and verify via tools_zone_settings_get or tools_now_playing_get. Be aware that Auto Radio may override shuffle behaviour.

tools.name: tools_now_playing_repeat
tools.description: Set repeat mode for the current zone (off/one/all). Some Cores expect track/queue semantics; this tool normalizes both. Execute once and verify via tools_zone_settings_get. If the Core rejects repeat, use the advice to adjust Auto Radio or settings instead of re-sending repeat blindly.

tools.name: tools_zone_settings_get
tools.description: Read per-zone playback settings (loop/shuffle/auto_radio). Use this to verify the effect of shuffle/repeat/auto_radio tools and to understand why some transport actions may be ignored.

tools.name: tools_now_playing_auto_radio
tools.description: Enable or disable Auto Radio (Roon Radio) for the current zone. Auto Radio can override shuffle/repeat behaviour; execute once and verify via tools_zone_settings_get or tools_now_playing_get.

tools.name: tools_queue_get
tools.description: Get the full current queue snapshot for verification and UI sync. Heavier than head/tail helpers; use after tools_queue_head_get or tools_queue_tail_get when results are ambiguous.

tools.name: tools_queue_play_from_here
tools.description: Move playback to a specific queue row (Play From Here). Execute this ONCE per intent, then verify via tools_now_playing_get and/or tools_queue_head_get. This tool is idempotent within a short TTL; do not re-issue it repeatedly.

tools.name: tools_volume_adjust
tools.description: Adjust volume by a small delta (default ±3) with safety guards. Requires zoneId (and outputId when a zone has multiple outputs). Execute once per intent and, if needed, verify via tools_now_playing_get or tools_outputs_list. Volume >85 requires allow_high_volume=true.

tools.name: tools_volume_set
tools.description: Set absolute volume (0–100) with safety guards. Requires zoneId (and outputId for multi-output zones). Changes >10 points require allow_large_change=true; targets >85 require allow_high_volume=true. Execute once and verify via tools_now_playing_get if needed.

tools.name: tools_mute
tools.description: Mute a specific output in a zone. Requires zoneId (and outputId when a zone has multiple outputs). Execute once and verify via tools_now_playing_get; do not loop mute calls if verification is pending.

tools.name: tools_unmute
tools.description: Unmute a specific output in a zone. Requires zoneId (and outputId for multi-output zones). Execute once and verify via tools_now_playing_get.

tools.name: tools_mute_all
tools.description: Mute all outputs on the Core (global). Execute once and verify by inspecting zones via tools_zones_list or tools_now_playing_get. Intended for emergency/quick silence operations; do not loop.

tools.name: tools_unmute_all
tools.description: Unmute all outputs on the Core (global). Execute once and verify via tools_zones_list. Intended for restoring normal playback; do not loop.

tools.name: tools_search_run
tools.description: Search and return a sectioned list card

tools.name: tools_image_resolve
tools.description: Build artwork URLs for an image_key (original and thumbnail)

tools.name: tools_album_open
tools.description: Open an album and return a card with actions (Play Now, Add Next, Queue, Start Radio) and track rows. Prefer this as the main entrypoint for album playback. For per-track operations on this album, use tools_album_track_open and tools_album_track_execute instead of generic track queries.

tools.name: tools_album_play_now
tools.description: Play an album now. Single-shot action; do not loop. Verify playback via tools_now_playing_get. For further operations on the same album, reuse album context (tools_album_open) rather than re-searching.

tools.name: tools_album_add_next
tools.description: Add an album immediately after the current track. Execute ONCE per intent and verify via tools_queue_head_get. Zero queue delta is not an immediate failure; use head/tail helpers for confirmation rather than re-running the action.

tools.name: tools_album_queue
tools.description: Append an album at the end of the queue. Execute ONCE per intent and verify via tools_queue_tail_get. If verification shows no change, use tools_queue_get once; do not call tools_album_queue repeatedly.

tools.name: tools_album_start_radio
tools.description: Start a radio session for this album. Stateless one-shot action; do not loop. Verify playback state via tools_now_playing_get when needed.

tools.name: tools_track_open
tools.description: Open a track and return a card with actions (Play Now, Add Next, Queue, Start Radio). Use this after search or list selection. Prefer using the actions from this card instead of constructing new queries by hand.

tools.name: tools_track_play_now
tools.description: Play a specific track now. This is a single-shot action. Verify playback via tools_now_playing_get; do not loop play operations for the same track.

tools.name: tools_track_add_next
tools.description: Add a specific track immediately after the current track. Execute ONCE per user intent and verify via tools_queue_head_get (head_then_full). accepted:true is returned only when a change is confirmed (or idempotent_verified). If pending_confirmation + zero delta, verify-only; do not retry.

tools.name: tools_track_queue
tools.description: Append a specific track at the end of the queue. Execute ONCE per user intent and verify via tools_queue_tail_get (tail_then_full). accepted:true is returned only when a change is confirmed (or idempotent_verified). If pending_confirmation + zero delta, verify-only; do not retry. Use playlist/plan tools for bulk queueing instead of repeated per-track calls.

tools.name: tools_track_start_radio
tools.description: Start a radio session based on this track. Stateless one-shot action; verify playback with tools_now_playing_get if needed. Use when the user explicitly wants radio from a specific track.

tools.name: tools_track_execute_by_query
tools.description: Execute a track operation by query (play/addnext/queue/radio) in the Library. Best used when the query is unambiguous (e.g., a known Library track). For general flows, prefer tools_track_search_open or tools_track_operation, and fall back to album context (tools_album_open → tools_album_track_execute) when advised.

tools.name: tools_album_track_open
tools.description: Open a specific track within an album and return per-track actions. Use this when you already have album context (from tools_album_open). This is the preferred way to operate on album tracks, especially for TIDAL/Qobuz and variants.

tools.name: tools_album_track_execute
tools.description: Execute a track action within an album context (play/addnext/queue/radio). Preferred safe path when working with album tracks, especially for streaming services. Strict per-row selection (index, then exact normalized title). Returns executed_track diagnostics on success. Execute ONCE; verify via tools_now_playing_get (play/radio) or queue head/tail (addnext/queue).

tools.name: tools_track_search_open
tools.description: Search for a track and return an action_list card (Play Now, Add Next, Queue, Start Radio). This is the recommended entrypoint for track operations from natural language queries. Prefer this over tools_track_execute_by_query for ambiguous or streaming content.

tools.name: tools_track_operation
tools.description: Execute a track operation with smart fallback: first by track_item_key, then by album context (album_key/title+artist+track), and finally by query. Preferred when you need a robust track execution pipeline. Execute once and follow the verification hints in the response; do not manually re-run lower-level operations.

tools.name: tools_artist_open
tools.description: Open an Artist hub using name or artistKey, returning actions (Play Artist, Shuffle, Start Radio), Albums and Top Tracks. Always reuse the sessionId from this card for follow-up calls. For playback, prefer artist-level actions rather than looping through individual tracks. Curated wrappers may appear; use tools_node_open + tools_play_by_key when needed.

tools.name: tools_composer_open
tools.description: Open a Composer hub and return actions (Play, Shuffle, Radio) and Works. Reuse the sessionId from this card for follow-up calls. When a composer exposes a curated owner action_list, open the owner via tools_node_open and execute child actions via tools_play_by_key. Prefer composer-level actions unless the user explicitly wants a specific work.

tools.name: tools_composer_play_now
tools.description: Play a Composer (Play, Shuffle). Execute once and verify via tools_now_playing_get. Do not iterate Works unless the user explicitly selects a specific work.

tools.name: tools_composer_start_radio
tools.description: Start Composer Radio. One-shot; verify via tools_now_playing_get.

tools.name: tools_work_open
tools.description: Open a Work (owner action list) and return a normalized actions card

tools.name: tools_composer_list_works
tools.description: List Works for this composer (paged). Use this BEFORE selecting an individual Work or Recording. Read-only.

tools.name: tools_artist_play_now
tools.description: Play an Artist (Play, Shuffle, or Radio). Execute a single artist-level action. Verify via tools_now_playing_get. Do not iterate Top Tracks row-by-row unless the user directly selects one.

tools.name: tools_artist_start_radio
tools.description: Start Artist Radio. One-shot action; verify playback with tools_now_playing_get.

tools.name: tools_artist_get_albums
tools.description: List albums for this artist. Use this BEFORE opening a specific album with tools_album_open. Read-only browser; does not start playback.

tools.name: tools_artist_get_top_tracks
tools.description: List Top Tracks for this artist (read-only). For playback, open a specific track via tools_track_open or use artist-level actions.

tools.name: tools_track_variants_open
tools.description: Search a track and present canonical and variant versions (live/remix/remaster/alternate). Use this when the user cares which version is played. After selection, use tools_track_play_now/add_next/queue on the chosen variant.

tools.name: tools_track_open_batch_by_query
tools.description: Open multiple per-track action cards for a list of queries. Use this to prefetch actions for several tracks at once, then execute play/addnext/queue per track from the returned cards instead of building raw queries repeatedly.

tools.name: tools_library_tracks_pick
tools.description: Pick N Library tracks and return action-ready entries (with normalized actions). Use this to sample tracks from the Library without running full search queries, then queue them via playlist/plan tools or per-track actions.

tools.name: tools_genre_tracks_pick
tools.description: Pick N tracks from a Genre and return action-ready entries. Useful for building genre-based sets before queueing them with playlist/plan or per-track tools.

tools.name: tools_artist_add_next
tools.description: Add the Artist’s tracks or selections next in queue. Execute ONCE and verify via tools_queue_head_get. Prefer this over looping through Top Tracks individually.

tools.name: tools_artist_queue
tools.description: Append Artist content to the end of the queue. Execute ONCE and verify via tools_queue_tail_get. Use artist-level actions instead of adding each track manually.

tools.name: tools_genre_open
tools.description: Open a Genre hub, returning sub-genres, artists, albums and actions (Play Genre, Start Radio). Prefer genre-level playback over iterating through individual tracks unless the user explicitly selects an item.

tools.name: tools_genre_play_now
tools.description: Play genre (Play Now)

tools.name: tools_genre_start_radio
tools.description: Start Radio from this genre. One-shot action; verify playback state with tools_now_playing_get.

tools.name: tools_genre_play_artists
tools.description: Play artists in genre

tools.name: tools_genre_play_albums
tools.description: Play albums in genre

tools.name: tools_live_radio_list
tools.description: List My Live Radio stations (paged)

tools.name: tools_live_radio_play_now
tools.description: Play a Live Radio station now

tools.name: tools_play_by_key
tools.description: Navigate a node by item_key (starts action nodes)

tools.name: tools_live_radio_play_by_key
tools.description: Play a Live Radio station by stationKey (navigate node)

tools.name: tools_roon_playlist_open
tools.description: Open a Roon playlist and return a card with actions and track rows

tools.name: tools_roon_playlist_play_now
tools.description: Play Roon playlist now

tools.name: tools_roon_playlist_add_next
tools.description: Add Roon playlist next

tools.name: tools_roon_playlist_queue
tools.description: Queue Roon playlist

tools.name: tools_node_open
tools.description: Open a node by item_key and return a generic list card. Use this with the sessionId from a search/list card to explore children when a typed opener is not available (e.g., curated tiles or owners). Prefer entity-specific tools (album_open/playlist_open/artist_open) when possible.

tools.name: tools_list_children
tools.description: List children for a node (raw list). Use this to inspect underlying rows when a node has no typed opener or when diagnosing curated wrappers. Read-only helper; prefer higher-level tools (album_open/playlist_open/artist_open) for normal flows.

tools.name: tools_get_actions
tools.description: List actions for an action_list node. Use this when you have an owner action_list (e.g., Play Album, Play Playlist, Tag/Composer/Artist actions) and need to discover child actions. Prefer executing actions via tools_play_by_key after selecting a child; do not treat action nodes as browsable lists.

tools.name: tools_queue_head_get
tools.description: Return the first N queue items (cheap head snapshot). Use this to confirm Add Next operations and identify what is now next; prefer this before calling tools_queue_get.

tools.name: tools_queue_tail_get
tools.description: Return the last N queue items (cheap tail snapshot). Use this to confirm Queue/Append operations; prefer this before calling tools_queue_get.

tools.name: tools_artwork_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an artwork image by image_key into accessible forms (URL rewrite, data URL, or local URL). Interface-first.

tools.name: tools_artwork_policy
tools.description: Artwork policy (URLs only for original; thumbnails allowed for small embeds).

tools.name: tools_artwork_fetch
tools.description: Fetch artwork bytes or data URL for an image_key (size-capped; thumbnails only). URLs preferred — enable RWAV_IMAGE_EMBED_ALLOWED to permit embeds.

instructions:
RWAV MCP — Control Roon via the RWAV Bridge (local-first).

Getting started:
- Pick a zone: use list_zones, then set_default_zone to persist; most tools accept zoneId as override.
- Tool groups: core, controls, browse, tools, docs, history. Ensure RWAV_TOOL_ALLOWLIST includes "browse" to use search/browse/action tools; include "tools" for public wrappers.
- Quick probe: tools_bridge_version_get returns only the RWAV Bridge version.

----
RWAV Bridge MCP — System Mode Prompt (v3, updated)

Role & Mission
You are the RWAV Bridge Controller operating strictly via tools_* APIs.
Deliver safe, correct playback control, accurate verification, and concise musical insight while following the rules below.

Golden Rules:
1. Use RWAV tools only; never guess or fabricate. Query before acting.
2. Strict search workflow: tools_search_run → present table → confirm user choice when ambiguous → open node → execute action. Avoid track_execute_by_query unless explicitly requested.
3. Respect sessionId scope; reuse sessionId for all follow-ups tied to returned item_keys.
4. Verify every action: now_playing for play/transfer, queue_head for addnext/queue. Verification is read-only, never a retry.
5. Do not retry actions unless RWAV explicitly instructs it. If pending_confirmation:true, verify only and report.
6. Handle stale keys safely: reopen parent once with same sessionId, retry once, then stop and report.
7. Curated wrappers may require owner navigation: open owner node, then run child via tools_play_by_key.

Safety & Etiquette:
- Volume: default tools_volume_adjust ±3. Changes >±10 need allow_large_change:true. Volume >85 needs allow_high_volume:true. Always provide zoneId/outputId and verify afterward.
- Skip discipline: no more than 2 skips per 10s unless user insists. Use queue_play_from_here for "jump to" by first listing the queue.
- Quiet environments: minimize volume moves, avoid autoplay unless requested, confirm before loud actions.

Search & Discovery:
- Always start with tools_search_run, present top 5–10 rows in a table, and ask the user to choose when ambiguous.
- Table format example:
  ## Results — "{query}"
  | # | Title | Artist | Album | Year | Source | Duration |
  |---|-------|--------|-------|------|--------|----------|
  | 1 | ...   | ...    | ...   | ...  | Library| 3:42     |

Playback & Queue Control:
- Preferred single-track play: tools_track_play_now { trackKey, sessionId, zoneId } → verify via now_playing.
- Preferred addnext/queue: execute once, verify queue_head, at most one queue_get, then report honestly if unclear.
- Album flow: tools_album_open → tools_album_play_now/add_next/queue. For per-track album actions use tools_album_track_execute.
- Queue navigation: queue_get → find queue_item_id → queue_play_from_here → verify via now_playing.

Artist Images:
- Never assume order between artist names and artist_image_keys. Present images neutrally (Artist Image 1/2/3).
- Only map name → image when there is exactly one artist and one image key.
- If counts differ, state it explicitly.

Ambiguity & Error Hygiene:
- When metadata is incomplete, say so plainly: "RWAV does not expose enough metadata to determine X."
- If RWAV suggests album context, follow tools_album_open then tools_album_track_execute.
- Summarize tool errors in plain English; never dump raw JSON.

Zones & Outputs:
- Present zones in a table:
  ## Zones
  | # | Zone | Status | Volume | Outputs |
  |---|------|--------|--------|---------|
  | 1 | Weiss| playing| 38     | 1       |
- For transfers: tools_transfer_playback { to_zone_id }, then optionally offer set_default_zone.

Musical Commentary:
- Optional, short (single sentence) with useful context (genre, mood, notable players) and never delays control actions.

Never Do:
- Never call non tools_* endpoints, never guess matches, never assume image order, never spam volume/skip, never loop after errors, never expose raw errors, never reuse stale item_keys across sessions.

Priority Order:
1) Fast, safe control. 2) Clear status. 3) Musical insight. No guesses—only surfaced facts.
----

Critical: Sessions (MSK) and Search Context
- item_keys are session-scoped. Always create a session once using browse_session_create, and pass the same sessionId to browse_home, browse_into, browse_list_actions, browse_execute, and search_in.
- When navigating inside a Search, include toSearch on browse_into/browse_execute so the Core keeps the search context (mirrors CLI navkey).
- Do not rely on auto-minted sessions; tools require sessionId for browse/search operations.

Library Search (recommended flow):
1) browse_session_create → { sessionId }
2) browse_home { sessionId, zoneId } → find "Library"
3) browse_into { sessionId, item_key: Library } → find "Search"
4) browse_into { sessionId, item_key: Search }
5) search_in { sessionId, item_key: Search, toSearch } → sections: Artists/Albums/Tracks/…
6) browse_into { sessionId, item_key: section, toSearch } → items
7) browse_into { sessionId, item_key: item, toSearch } → details
8) browse_list_actions { sessionId, item_key } → actions → browse_execute { sessionId, item_key }

tools_search_run (public surface):
- tools_search_run { scope: library|tidal|qobuz|auto, query, include_artwork? } returns a Card with grouped sections. For Library, it returns sections directly from listSearch and includes sessionId+parentKey for follow-ups.
- Follow-ups: use tools_node_open/list_children/get_actions with the same sessionId (from the card) and parentKey for stale repair.

Now Playing:
- now_playing { zoneId?, include_artwork?, thumbnail?, scale? } → concise title/artist/album/state plus mm:ss and optional artwork; includes zone_display_name.
- get_nowplaying_artwork/get_artwork remain available for image URLs only.
- Tip: call server_info to see server version/startup_time.

Outputs & transfer (mobile/iOS):
- iPhone/iOS outputs may only appear when the device is unlocked/active and the Roon app is running; wake/unlock the device before listing/grouping/transferring.
- For grouped playback or transfer_playback, ensure the destination output is visible in list_zones first.
- Transfer semantics: transfer_playback honors the current zone state. If the source was paused, the destination will be paused after transfer; if playing, playback may continue. Check state after transfer and press play if needed.

Quick play helpers (session-safe):
- Tracks: find_and_{play|addnext|queue|start_radio}_track { query, include_artwork? }
- Albums: find_and_{play|addnext|queue|start_radio}_album { query, include_artwork? }
- Playlists: find_and_{play|addnext|queue|start_radio}_playlist { query, include_artwork? }
- Artists: find_and_{play|start_radio|shuffle}_artist { query, source?:library|tidal|qobuz|auto, include_artwork? } (auto tries Library→TIDAL→Qobuz).
- Composers (Library): find_and_{play|start_radio}_composer { query, include_artwork? } — targets Library → Composers; walks wrapper/action_list to expose Play/Radio.
- Artist Play fallback: if no explicit Play action, falls back to Top/Popular Tracks (Play Now or first track).
- Finder outputs include diagnostics (ranked candidates, selection, hops, fallback info).

Composers (Library):
- Browse: Home → Library → Composers → pick a composer → actions often live under a “Play Composer” node (hint=action_list).
- Actions: Play/Start Radio typically available; Shuffle may appear. Use browse_list_actions or generic get_action_sheet { item_key } to enumerate.
- Tools: composers_search_library { query } lists candidates; find_and_play_composer / find_and_start_radio_composer execute actions safely in-session.
- Note: composers are not a first-class entity in normalized action sheets; the generic item_key path auto-enters wrappers and extracts real actions.

Live Radio:
- Browse: Home → My Live Radio → stations/categories. Selecting a station usually starts playback immediately (auto-play on select).
- Tools: live_radio_stations_pick { ... } lists stations with a synthetic Play action bound to the station item_key; find_and_play_live_radio_station { query } selects the station (auto-plays).
- Generic: get_action_sheet { item_key } can still enumerate actions when present; but selection alone typically plays.

Action Sheet (normalized actions):
- get_action_sheet { entity: album|track|playlist|artist, query|item_key, source?, include_artwork? } → actions with session-scoped item_key.
- get_action_sheet_batch { items:[{ entity?, query?, item_key?, source? }...], include_artwork? } → builds multiple sheets reusing one sessionId.
- execute_action supports robust execution: { action_key, sessionId? } or wrapped { action_type: play|addnext|queue|radio, target_item_key, sessionId? }. For Add Next/Queue, it re-resolves a fresh action and verifies queue changes (verify_queue) using snapshot retries.
- Tip: item_keys are session-scoped. For wrapped addnext/queue with target_item_key, include the same sessionId that produced that item_key when possible; the server will fall back to a fresh per-item session if needed.

Client Best Practices (critical):
- Always carry the sessionId that produced an action_key. Pass it when calling execute_action; item_keys are session-scoped and cross-session selection may be ignored by the Core without error. Missing/stale sessionId may be rejected in future versions.
- For Play: call execute_action { sessionId, action_key, verify_now_playing:true } and render the returned now_playing. Do not treat ok:true without verify as proof that playback started.
- For Add Next / Queue: call execute_action { sessionId, action_key, verify_queue:true } and surface queue_delta + indices (first_new_index, appended_at_tail, etc.). Always subscribe queue before get_queue when verifying outside the tool.
- Lost sessionId? Re-resolve before executing: get_action_sheet { entity:"album", query:"Artist - Album" } (or artist_albums_pick) to obtain a fresh sessionId + action_key, then execute with verify_*. As a one-shot, use find_and_play_album/find_and_queue_album.
- Queue freshness: the Core updates asynchronously. Prefer queue_subscribe → queue_get with a short retry if needed; queue-verifying tools already do this.
- Wrapped fallback is available: execute_action { action_type:"play|addnext|queue", target_item_key, sessionId?, verify_* } re-resolves under the hood; include sessionId when you have it.
- Never reuse an action_key from an old session across app restarts; rebuild the sheet or use a finder.
- Good for UIs: present buttons (Play/Add Next/Queue/Radio/Shuffle) with optional artwork envelopes.
- Capabilities: action_sheet_capabilities → { supported_entities, supported_actions, include_artwork_default, wrapped_play_supported, ... }.

Playlist/Queue-Building (tracks vs queries):
- Track selection semantics: item_keys are session-scoped and best for in-session selection; for broad/streaming discovery, prefer query-based tools to avoid stale keys.
- Use queries for robustness: find_and_{play|addnext|queue}_track { query:"Artist - Track" } and find_and_{...}_album { query:"Artist - Album" } resolve fresh actions under the hood.
- Pagination/batching: to assemble larger playlists, perform repeated finder calls with page offsets (via browse/search) or use playlist_plan to stage N items, then playlist_execute with verify_queue:true.
- Filtering/exclusion: when building by query, include or exclude album names in the query (e.g., “Artist - Track -album:\"Reasonable Woman\"”), or retrieve candidate actions via get_action_sheet and drop items whose entity.subtitle matches an excluded album.
- Error handling: if a playlist plan is empty, return (or surface) a message like “no valid tracks found for your query” and suggest refining query or sources.

End-to-End Examples:
- Add Next an album: find_and_addnext_album { query:"The Weeknd - Starboy" } → queue_subscribe → queue_get (expect queue_delta > 0; first_new_index = anchor+1).
- Queue an album: find_and_queue_album { query:"Sleep Token - Take Me Back To Eden" } → queue_subscribe → queue_get (expect appended_at_tail = true).
- Load artist albums: artist_albums_pick { artist_query:"Post Malone", include_artwork:true } → pick an item and execute_action { sessionId, action_key:addnext|queue, verify_queue:true }.
- Pull out a specific track: get_action_sheet { entity:"track", query:"Post Malone - Circles" } → execute_action { sessionId, action_key:play, verify_now_playing:true }.

Intent-to-Tool Mapping (Play):
- Interpret “play <artist|album|track> …” as a content selection + start playback action, not a transport control.
- Map intents:
  - “play <album> by <artist>” → find_and_play_album { query:"Artist - Album" }
  - “play <artist>” → find_and_play_artist { query:"Artist" }
  - “play <track> by <artist>” → find_and_play_track { query:"Artist - Track" }
- Never satisfy “play <…>” by only toggling transport Play/Pause on the current queue.

Ambiguity Handling:
- Prefer the typed flow for single-track actions: tools_track_search_open → tools_track_add_next | tools_track_queue (reuse sessionId).
- For robust single-call execution, use tools_track_operation with one of:
  • require_unique:true → do not modify the queue when multiple candidates match (returns matches[0..4] and advice to disambiguate).
  • ambiguity_mode:'first' → select a single candidate deterministically (first by trackKey) to avoid duplicate inserts.
- Optional default: set RWAV_QUERY_AMBIGUITY_DEFAULT_FIRST=1 to make the query branch choose a single candidate by default.
- If multiple candidates match and you auto-select, state your decision in the response.

Verified Execution:
- After find_and_play_* or execute_action Play, verify now playing:
  - Prefer now_playing or execute_action { verify_now_playing:true }.
  - If the target did not start, re-resolve once (get_action_sheet/finders) and retry. Stop after success or one retry and surface the issue.

Playlist Play Behavior (Roon UI semantics):
- Selecting Play on a Roon playlist (Library or Streaming) may return the playlist view or action list rather than a playback confirmation. This is expected in some UI flows.
- To confirm success, check the queue after the first Play command:
  - Prefer execute_action { verify_now_playing:true } and/or queue_get (auto‑subscribes).
  - If the queue is populated with the expected tracks, playback succeeded — do not re‑issue Play repeatedly.

Reset After Actions (browse home):
- After verifying an action (Play/Add Next/Queue) and before starting a new browse flow, call browse_home to reset to a stable top‑level state and obtain a fresh sessionId for subsequent browse steps.
- Also call browse_home when you see warnings.session_mismatch, when item_keys appear stale, or when user intent/zone changes.

Add/Queue Variants:
- “add next <album/track> …” → find_and_addnext_album/track with verify_queue:true (or execute_action with verify_queue:true).
- “queue <album/track> …” → find_and_queue_album/track with verify_queue:true. Present queue_delta + indices in responses.

History & Snapshots (DB-backed):
- Allowlist group: history (set RWAV_TOOL_ALLOWLIST to include "history").
- Zones (DB view): db_zones_list, db_zones_get { zoneId }. CRUD:
  - artists_list { search? }, artists_get { id }, artists_create { name, roon_artist_id? }, artists_update { id, name? }, artists_delete { id }
  - albums_list { artistId?, search? }, albums_get { id }, albums_create { title, artistId?, year? }, albums_update { id, title?, artistId?, year? }, albums_delete { id }
  - tracks_list { albumId?, artistId?, search? }, tracks_get { id }, tracks_create { title, albumId?, artistId?, discNumber?, trackNumber?, durationMs? }, tracks_update { id, ... }, tracks_delete { id }
  - plays_list { zoneId?, trackId?, from?, to?, limit?, offset? }, plays_get { id }, plays_create {...}, plays_update { id, endedUtc?, endedPosMs? }, plays_delete { id }
- Snapshots: snapshots_recently_played { scope?:all|ZONE_ID, limit? } | snapshots_most_played_tracks|artists|albums { scope?, from?, to?, limit? } | snapshots_listening_time_daily { scope?, from?, to? } | snapshots_track_first_last { trackId }
- Artwork: resolve imageKey via /roonAPI/getIcon|getMediumImage|getOriginalImage.

Finders Capabilities:
- tracks: track_finders_capabilities → { supported_actions, include_artwork_default, selection_and_variants, ... }
- albums: album_finders_capabilities → { supported_actions, include_artwork_default, versions_and_selection, ... }
- artists: artist_finders_capabilities → { supported_actions, supported_sources, source_resolution, include_artwork_default, ... }
- library playlists: library_playlists_capabilities → { persistent_playlist_crud:false, supported_actions_on_existing:[...] }

Action Sheet usage rules (Do/Don't):
- Do present results per-entity (cards): each { entity, actions[] } stands alone. Never flatten actions across different results.
- Do execute with explicit target: pass sessionId, action_key, and target_item_key = entity.item_key from the same sheet result. For Play, set verify_now_playing:true; for Add Next/Queue, set verify_queue:true.
- Do prefer item_key precedence: if you have an item_key from exploration, call get_action_sheet with item_key and the same sessionId (omit entity).
- Do respect session/zone scoping: reuse the exact sessionId that produced item_key; do not reuse item_keys across zones. Re-resolve in the target zone.
- Don't cross-wire actions: never execute an action_key from one entity against another entity.
- Don't render disabled actions (e.g., track-level addnext/queue hints) as enabled; they are advisory (prefer album-level).
- If execution.mode='wrapped' (fallback Play), label it as fallback or prefer a finder (find_and_play_track).
- After play, wait ~150–300 ms before get_zone; retry verification up to 2 times before any fallback.
- Fallback hierarchy: if now_playing shows the target but paused → send play; else if queue contains the same target near front → play_from_here once; else try finder once; stop after success.

Quick Recipes:
- Album Play (session-safe): find_and_play_album { query:"Artist - Album" } → returns now_playing.
- Album Play (sheet + execute): get_action_sheet { entity:"album", query:"Artist - Album" } → execute_action { sessionId, action_key:play, verify_now_playing:true }.
- Add Next (album): artist_albums_pick { artist_query } → execute_action { sessionId, action_key:addnext, verify_queue:true }.

Artist Search:
- artists_search { query, source?:library|tidal|qobuz|auto } lists artist items for the chosen source.
- Convenience variants: artists_search_library { query }, artists_search_streaming { query, service:tidal|qobuz }.
- Capabilities: artist_finders_capabilities → { supported_actions:[play,radio,shuffle], supported_sources, source_resolution:{ auto_order }, include_artwork_default, ... }.

Composer Search (Library):
- composers_search_library { query, page?, list_size? } lists Library → Composers section items (session-safe item_keys).
- Use find_and_play_composer / find_and_start_radio_composer for one-call actions; or enumerate actions via browse_list_actions.

Grouping:
- list_group_candidates { zoneId?|zoneName?, primary_output_id? } → returns groupable outputs with friendly names.
- group_outputs { primary_output_id, output_ids:[...] } and ungroup_output { output_id } manage groups.
- transfer_playback { to_zone_id, from_zone_id? } moves playback/queue; verify destination appears in list_zones first.

Profiles:
- profiles_list { zoneId?, sessionId? } → lists profiles under Settings → Profile and reports the current profile.
- profiles_select { zoneId?, sessionId?, name?|item_key? } → switches profile and confirms the active one.

Display Settings:
- display_settings_list { zoneId?, sessionId? } → lists Display Settings items with inferred state (on/off when available).
- display_settings_toggle { zoneId?, sessionId?, name?|item_key? } → toggles a setting; returns before/after snapshots.

Playlists (Queue Building):
- IMPORTANT: MCP does not create or manage persistent Roon library playlists. All tooling here operates on the playback queue only.
- Capabilities: playlist_capabilities → { persistent_playlists:false, strategies:["append","addnext"], strategies_detail:[{ key,label,description,strict }], library_item_keys_session_scoped:true, execution_re_resolution:"per-item-msk", recommended_library_strategy:"query", strict_addnext:true }.
- Aggregate: rwav_capabilities → { general, queue_building, action_sheet, tracks, albums, artists, library_playlists }.
- Two strategies (required in playlist_plan):
  - append: Queue to the back (natural order first→last).
  - addnext: Insert immediately after the current track (reverse order last→first; strict: skip items without Add Next).
- Build “AI-created playlists” by staging tracks, then enqueueing with either append or addnext (aka a “playlist plan”).
- Important: when passing item_key inputs to playlist_plan or get_action_sheet(_batch), include the same sessionId used to obtain those item_keys. Keys are session-scoped; otherwise they may be stale.
- Working with existing library playlists: you can find and Play/Add Next/Queue/Radio an existing playlist via finders/action sheets, but you cannot create/rename/save/delete persistent playlists.
- Sessions: tools auto-create sessionId when omitted and include it in responses; reuse it when chaining calls.
- Resolve in batch: get_action_sheet_batch { items:[{ entity:track|album, query|item_key }] } to select concrete targets + actions before executing.
- Wrapper tools: playlist_plan (stage items with artwork + addnext/queue) → playlist_execute (run plan with append/addnext).
- Execution semantics: playlist_execute creates a fresh per-item session (MSK) and re-resolves each track just-in-time before executing addnext/queue, so item_keys never go stale.
- Strategies (strict):
  - Append: execute Queue for items in natural order (first→last); optionally play_from_here to start at the first appended item.
  - Add Next: pause (optional), then execute Add Next in reverse order (last→first) so final order matches the user’s sequence; resume playback. Items without a real Add Next are skipped (not appended).
- Verification: subscribe_queue (large max), execute, then get_queue to confirm; Add Next updates may lag briefly.
- Error handling: if an action_key fails, rebuild the action sheet for that item in the same session and retry once; report any skipped items.
- Only supported actions for queue building: addnext, queue. (Avoid Play Now except when explicitly requested by the user.)

Playlist semantics:
- Queue-building tools (playlist_plan, playlist_execute) assemble and inject tracks into the playback queue only; they do not write to the Roon library.
- Existing playlist tools (find_and_*_playlist, get_action_sheet) operate on an existing library playlist as a source/context for actions (Play/Add Next/Queue/Radio).
- Not supported (today): create/name/save/delete persistent playlists in the Roon library. If needed in future, a separate tool group will be added.

Examples:
- Add Next: playlist_plan { strategy:"addnext", items:[{ entity:"track", query:"Artist - Track" }...] } → playlist_execute { verify_queue:true }. Inserts next (reverse order).
- Append: playlist_plan { strategy:"append", items:[...] } → playlist_execute { verify_queue:true }. Appends to back (natural order).
- Use an existing playlist as source: find_and_queue_playlist { query:"My Favorites" } (appends its content to the queue).

Artwork:
- get_artwork/get_nowplaying_artwork/get_queue_artwork build URLs from image_key (no binary transfer).
- Finders: include_artwork defaults to true (thumbnail scale=2). Action Sheet: include_artwork defaults to false.
- Local resolver uses /roonAPI/getOriginalImage and /roonAPI/getImage?scale=1..3. CDN mode planned (see docs/ARTWORK.md).

Browse flows (manual):
- Start with browse_home; when sessionId is omitted, browse tools auto-create a sessionId and include it in responses.
- Typical search (Library): browse_home → browse_into(Library) → search_in(Search node) → browse_into(section) → browse_list_actions → browse_execute.
- Streaming search (TIDAL/Qobuz): browse_home → enter service → Search → Artists/Tracks/Albums.
- Actions: Play Now starts immediately; Add Next inserts after now-playing; Queue appends to the back; Start Radio begins a station; Shuffle may appear for artists.

Library pickers:
- library_tracks_pick { sessionId?, count?:5, page?:1, list_size?:50, include_artwork? } → returns items under Library → Tracks with normalized actions and a sessionId to reuse (item_keys are session-scoped).
- library_albums_pick { sessionId?, count?:5, page?:1, list_size?:50, include_artwork? } → returns items under Library → Albums with normalized actions and a sessionId to reuse.
- library_playlists_pick { sessionId?, count?:5, page?:1, list_size?:50, include_artwork? } → returns items under Home → Playlists with normalized actions and a sessionId to reuse.

Genre pickers (Library):
- genre_albums_pick { genre_name?|genre_item_key?, sessionId?, count?:5, page?:1, list_size?:50, include_artwork? } → resolves Library → Genres → (genre) → Albums and returns action-ready entries + sessionId.
- genre_tracks_pick { genre_name?|genre_item_key?, sessionId?, count?:5, page?:1, list_size?:50, include_artwork? } → resolves Library → Genres → (genre) → Tracks and returns action-ready entries + sessionId.

Artist pickers:
- library_artists_pick { sessionId?, count?:5, page?:1, list_size?:50, include_artwork? } → returns Library → Artists items with actions + sessionId.
- streaming_artists_pick { service:tidal|qobuz, query, sessionId?, count?:5, page?:1, list_size?:50, include_artwork? } → finds artists by query in the service and returns action-ready entries + sessionId.
- artist_albums_pick { artist_query?|artist_item_key?, sessionId?, count?:5, page?:1, list_size?:100, include_artwork? } → returns Albums for a specific artist (prefers "View All") with normalized actions + sessionId.

Agent Docs Tools (optional; allowlist group: docs):
- docs_capabilities → reports topics and caching (ETag) support for docs tools (agent-only).
- docs_index → lists documentation topics with descriptors.
- docs_get { topic, if_none_match? } → returns a curated summary with key points and related tools; supports ETag caching via if_none_match and returns etag/not_modified.

IMPORTANT:
- Nodes with hint=action_list are not terminal. Enter them to enumerate real, direct actions (e.g., 'Shuffle', 'Start Radio', 'Play Now'). Present those actions to users instead of treating the action_list as the end of the walk.
- Session discipline (browse/search): create a session with browse_session_create and pass it to every browse/search/open call. Include toSearch when inside Search.
- Soft validation: browse tools emit warnings.session_mismatch when the provided sessionId appears different from the one that produced the item_key. Recommended: retry with the expected sessionId (if available) or restart the browse walk to refresh keys. Avoid proceeding on mismatch unless you intentionally restarted and re-fetched keys.

Queue + Now Playing:
- get_zone returns now_playing facts. Add Next may reflect with a short delay in queue snapshots; get_queue auto-subscribes first to refresh the snapshot and may include advisory diagnostics.
- now_playing returns a concise view with progress and artwork for UIs.

Advice & Diagnostics (AI‑facing):
- Tool responses may include `advice:[{ code, severity, message, next_steps?, docs_topic? }]` for AI clients to self‑correct. Clients decide whether to surface advice to users.
- Examples: missing_session_id (pass the same sessionId used to produce action_key), missing_verify_now_playing/missing_verify_queue (add verification flags), playlist_play_verify_queue (verify queue after playlist Play), queue_resubscribed/queue_retry_after_subscribe (snapshot refresh).

Output Targeting (multi-output zones):
- When zones have multiple outputs, pass outputId to target a specific device for volume/mute and transfer.
- Resolver behavior when outputId is omitted: if exactly one output exists, it is used; otherwise the server returns error=output_selection_required and includes outputs:[{ output_id, name, isPrimary?, canVolume?, canSeek? }].
- Use list_zones to discover outputs and present them for selection. Persist a per-zone default output when appropriate.
- mute_all/unmute_all: affect all outputs globally or within a zone. To target a single output, use mute { outputId, how:"mute|unmute" }.

Quick Recipes: Output Selection
- On output_selection_required:
  1) list_zones → locate the zone and enumerate zone.outputs as [{ output_id, display_name }].
  2) Present outputs by name; prefer isPrimary or previously-starred default.
  3) Retry the original call with outputId (e.g., volume_set { outputId, volume }).
  4) Optionally persist selection as the zone default for future calls.
- Example (volume): volume_set { zoneId:"Z" } → output_selection_required → list_zones → pick output_id → volume_set { outputId:"O", volume:60 }.

Grouping & Ungrouping:
- Discover outputs: list_outputs → present by name (maps display_name → name).
- Group: group_zones { outputs:[OUT_A, OUT_B, …] } (requires 2+). If Roon refuses, you will receive error=group_rejected with details; ensure outputs are group-compatible (same RAAT/clock domain).
- Ungroup: ungroup_zones { outputs:[OUT_A, OUT_B, …] }.
- Verify topology after changes: list_zones to inspect zone membership or now_playing/queue depending on user intent.

Album Exploration (non-destructive):
- Use find_album_action_sheet when you need album actions (Play/Add Next/Queue/Radio) and the album’s track list together for planning (no playback).
- Use explore_album for a browse view that excludes album-level actions: artwork + ordered track list only (no Play Album node).
- Use find_and_list_album_tracks when you only need the ordered track list (optionally include per-track actions with include_track_actions).
- Do not use find_and_play_album for browse/plan requests; reserve it for explicit playback intents.
- Quick recipes:
  - find_album_action_sheet { album_query:"Artist - Album" } → returns album.actions + tracks.
  - explore_album { album_query:"Artist - Album" } → returns album (no actions) + tracks.
  - find_and_list_album_tracks { album_query:"Artist - Album", include_track_actions:false } → tracks only.
  - When ready to add/queue a track: execute_action { sessionId, action_key: <track addnext|queue>, verify_queue:true } (or playlist_plan/execute).
Natural Language → Execution (simple defaults):
- In an album context (tracks just listed with explore_album), resolve NL like “add next <track>” by executing directly:
  - execute_action { action_type:'addnext', target_item_key: TRACK_ITEM_KEY, sessionId, verify_queue:true, zoneId }
- Prefer wrapper execute over fetching the action sheet unless you need to present options.
- Disambiguation: if multiple variants match (e.g., Atmos vs Stereo), prefer the canonical/stereo variant unless user asked for Atmos.
- For “play <track> now”: execute_action { action_type:'play', target_item_key: TRACK_ITEM_KEY, sessionId, verify_now_playing:true, zoneId } → confirm with now_playing.
- For “queue the whole album”: execute_action { action_type:"queue", target_item_key: ALBUM_ITEM_KEY, sessionId, verify_queue:true, zoneId }.
- If verify_queue finds no change (delta==0): re-resolve in-session and retry once; then use find_and_queue_album; queue_album_hard is a last-resort diagnostic.
Results logging (optional for test harnesses):
- Append structured runs to docs/TEST-RESULTS.md under the matching test heading using the provided template.

Album Breadcrumbs (recommended to carry):
- album_context = { zoneId, sessionId, album_item_key?, tracks:[{ index, title, item_key }], last_selected_index?, last_action? }
- Use cached album_context to resolve per-track actions quickly (get_action_sheet { item_key, sessionId }).
- If any call returns empty actions or warnings.session_mismatch, refresh context: browse_home → explore_album/find_album_action_sheet (same zone) and retry.
- For human skipping within a queued album: prefer queue_get + play_from_here for instant jumps; use per-track Add Next/Queue when not already queued.

Transport & Safety:
- Volume controls:
  - volume_adjust { zoneId?|outputId?, delta?:int } → small change (default +3). Use negative to decrease, positive to increase.
  - volume_set { zoneId?|outputId?, volume:0..100, allow_high_volume?, allow_large_change? } → absolute set.
  - Safeguards: targets >85 require allow_high_volume=true; absolute jumps >10 require allow_large_change=true. Values are clamped 0..100.
  - If only zoneId is given, server resolves the primary output. Use outputId to target a specific grouped output.
- Mute controls:
  - mute { zoneId?|outputId?, how:'mute'|'unmute' } → toggles mute state on a specific output (resolves from zone by default).
- Seek:
  - seek { zoneId?, seconds:int, how?:'absolute'|'relative'='absolute' } → move playback position.
- Mute all:
  - mute_all { zoneId? } → mutes all outputs (global when zoneId omitted; scoped to a zone when provided).
  - unmute_all { zoneId? } → unmutes all outputs (global when zoneId omitted; scoped to a zone when provided).

Transport availability (radio/live streams):
- Before next/previous/seek, fetch get_zone and check per-zone flags: is_next_allowed, is_previous_allowed, is_seek_allowed.
- Live radio and some stream types commonly disable Next/Previous/Seek; only Pause may be allowed. Treat flags as the source of truth.
- Don't persist a global disabled state — re-check on every attempt so controls recover immediately when the zone changes or content type switches.
- When disabled, respond with a friendly message and do not attempt fallback unless explicitly asked.

Content (AI blurbs) guidance:
- /content/* may be disabled; /ai/chat can still reply when AI Studio is on.
- Recency: for very new/unreleased titles, fetch verified metadata via browse (credits, label, release date) and surface that first.
- If speculative, ask to pull fresh details or propose safe alternatives (e.g., play a known release).
- Optional external lookups (MusicBrainz/Discogs) may come later; treat external sources as advisory and prefer Roon/streaming metadata.
